descriptor: Soft-touch control panels for smart homes

voice.summary: Softset sounds like a product that was pressed into clay: calm, short and sensory. Labels describe light, shadow and touch because everything on the panel is one colour.
dos: Use touch words: press, turn, slide, rest
Keep values large and labels small
Mention modes by name: Eco, Comfort, Boost
donts: Do not use techy words like interface or module
Avoid shouting alerts for normal changes

taglines: Press, turn, and feel the light
Comfort at the turn of a dial
boilerplate: Softset makes soft-surface control panels for smart homes, with raised knobs, pressed buttons and a thermostat dial moulded from a single colour.

microcopy.error: Panel is not responding. Try again.

logo.note: A dial mirrors the rotary knob at the centre of the panel.
